component.name: ChatQT
component.summary: A simple AI chat client for OpenAI-compatible providers

description.p: ChatQT is a native KDE application that provides a simple and intuitive interface for chatting with AI models via OpenAI-compatible APIs.
Multiple provider support: Connect to Ollama, OpenClaw, or any OpenAI-compatible API.
Simple interface: Clean and intuitive design built with Kirigami for a seamless experience.
Native KDE integration: Built with Qt/QML for seamless Plasma desktop experience.
Chat management: Clear chat history and control auto-scroll behavior.

Refocusing release. ChatQT had drifted from its original goal of being a simple chat assistant. This version realigns the project with its core purpose, removing features that belong in coding agents — not chat clients — and ensuring cleaner, more maintainable code.

ul.li: Removed coding agent features (OpenCode, Pi process managers, SkillScanner, AGENTS.md loader) that were outside the app's chat assistant scope
Removed stdio MCP server support and built-in MCP defaults (bash-mcp, filesystem) which required flatpak-spawn — only remote (Streamable HTTP) MCP servers remain
Removed flatpak-spawn --host and --talk-name=org.freedesktop.Flatpak for Flathub compliance
Added Soul: define the AI's personality and behavior directly in settings
Added Memory: the AI can save important information to remember across conversations
Added save_memory tool for persistent memory management
Fixed OpenAI-compatible providers not continuing after MCP tool calls
Fixed session restoration for OpenAI-compatible providers
Fixed empty assistant bubbles taking up space when only thinking content is present
Fixed tool messages appearing as empty assistant bubbles on session restore

description.p: Bug fix release addressing thinking display and Flatpak tray icon issues.

ul.li: Fix thinking/reasoning content not displaying in the collapsible block for OpenAI-compatible providers
Fix system tray icon not appearing in the Flatpak build
Removed default skill folder paths (users now add folders manually)

description.p: Initial stable release of ChatQT, a native AI chat client for KDE Plasma built with Qt6, QML, and Kirigami.

ul.li: Connect to Ollama with automatic model discovery
Connect to any OpenAI-compatible API with multi-provider support
Streaming responses with real-time display
Toggle extended thinking/reasoning for supported models
Persistent chat sessions with sidebar navigation
Remote MCP (Model Context Protocol) server support
System tray integration
Flatpak support
